crossRefs.note: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.
Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the…
‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have…
Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’
Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful…
For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
translations.bsb: Do not oppress a foreign resident, since you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
translations.asv: And a sojourner shalt thou not oppress: for ye know the heart of a sojourner, seeing ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
